  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lychees/threejs-water-1/main/public/models/coast/coast_rocks_05/textures/coast_rocks_05_diff_1k.jpg
  and vs https://raw.githubusercontent.com/whoami22888/isles-of-mythos/main/client-godot/assets/external/polyhaven/coast_rocks_05/ (same bytes).

intended use: SM_Rock_D (rock cluster ~5 m) - PRIMARY. Low, flat cluster of weathered tan shore rocks with seaweed/sand patches,
  4.0 x 3.7 x 1.3 m (scale x1.2-1.3 for 5 m). Best fit for beaches / shoreline. Ready-made LODs: web = LOD0 (29.9k), mid = LOD1 (3.0k),
  low = LOD2 (1.3k). For a <=15k LOD0, decimate "web" or use "mid" + normal map.

tech notes (verified 2026-10-28):

  coast_rocks_05_mid.gltf: Blender 5.2 glTF import OK, missing images: 0; 2,993 tris; 1 mesh object(s); bbox (m, X/Y/Z-up) [4.033, 3.746, 1.306]; materials ['coast_rocks_05']; textures: coast_rocks_05_diff 1024x1024, coast_rocks_05_nor_gl 1024x1024, coast_rocks_05_rough 1024x1024
  coast_rocks_05_web.gltf: Blender 5.2 glTF import OK, missing images: 0; 29,903 tris; 1 mesh object(s); bbox (m, X/Y/Z-up) [4.034, 3.746, 1.328]; materials ['coast_rocks_05']; textures: coast_rocks_05_diff 1024x1024, coast_rocks_05_nor_gl 1024x1024, coast_rocks_05_rough 1024x1024
  Normal map OpenGL (+Y) -> flip green in UE. ARM = AO/rough/metal. Re-pivot to base-centre in the dai pipeline.

Raw index counts 29,985 / 2,995 / 1,322 tris match that file exactly (Blender drops a few degenerate tris -> 29,903 / 2,993 / 1,320). The LODs are mechanical simplifications (no new creative authorship); the host repo has no LICENSE file of its own. Second mirror re-checked: diff texture MATCH lychees/threejs-water-1.
  note: the snapshot's last column (1,446,981) is Poly Haven's polycount metadata, not this 1k glTF's triangle count; the same kind of gap appears on assets whose glTF is byte-identical across independent mirrors, so it is not evidence of modification.
  verdict: ACCEPT (CC0-1.0, no attribution required).
